source: QED 4-loop photon self-energy — TwoBubbles topology — staged mass2 variant: propagators D1 = l1^2 and D2 = (l1+p1)^2 carry mass me^2; the 6 other originally-electron propagators (D3, D5, D6, D7, D8, D11) are made massless. The 3 photon propagators (D4, D9, D10) remain massless. ISPs are D12-D14 = (p1+l2)^2, (p1+l4)^2, (l1+l3)^2. Kinematics: p1^2 = 0 (on-shell photon ext), me^2 = 1, eps = 1/1000. dot = 5, rank = 0.
notes: C++ amflow_cli ran 13h30m on this case at dot=5 without producing output. Same root cause as mass1: branch-mode tie-breaker places eta on a massless propagator. mass2 had 7 masters vs mass1's 18, so the C++ side did NOT crash but instead got stuck in extremely slow polynomial reduction during a single Kira sub-iteration. User-terminated. See notes/future_optimization_proposals.md.
